description:
Responsibilities:  · Design and discuss feature storyboards and wireframes  · Develop new user-facing features  · Build reusable code and libraries for future use  · Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs  · Optimize application for maximum speed and scalability  · Assure that all user input is validated before submitting to back-end  · Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders  Qualifications:  · Bachelor’s degree  ·6 years of UI coding experience with various languages including HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap  · Proficient understanding of client-side scripting and JavaScript frameworks, including jQuery  · Experience using javascript MVVM framework(s) such as AngularJS, KnockoutJS, BackboneJS, ReactJS, DurandalJS etc.  · Good understanding of asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and AJAX  · Experience with prototyping tools for wireframing  · Experience with image authoring tools with the ability to crop, resize or perform small adjustments on an image. Familiarity with tools such as Gimp or Photoshop is a plus.  · Understand cross-browser compatibility issues and ability to resolve  · Proficient understanding of code versioning tools  · Good understanding of ASP.NET MVC is a plus.


 HTML5, UX, UI, Bootstrap, CSS3, KnockoutJS, BackboneJS, DurandalJS, MVVM,
